titles.en: Stele of the Ritual Vessels, original stone

currentCollection.note: The stone has inscriptions on the front, back, and sides; the museum article gives 16 lines of 36 characters on the front and no dimensions.
currentCollection.noteZh: 碑阳、碑阴与碑侧均有刻字；馆方文章记碑阳 16 行、满行 36 字，没有尺寸。

date.note: The source gives an approximate period rather than a precise date.

provenanceEvents.summary: The stele was moved into the newly completed Qufu Han–Wei Stele Gallery, after earlier moves from the Tongwen Gate to the east wing in 1978.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 此碑在 1978 年由同文门移入东庑，1998 年移入新落成的曲阜汉魏碑刻陈列馆。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft object record. The collection assertion comes from the cited page but has not been reviewed against the object itself.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：草稿记录。现藏依据来自所引页面，但尚未与实物核对，也未经独立审核。

notes: The cited page states the date, the scribe where one is recorded, and the holding institution.
Excavation, accession, and present display status are not stated in the audited source and are left blank.
No coordinate is recorded: the source names an institution, not a surveyed point.
Dimensions are not given in the audited pages.
notesZh: 所引页面记载了刻立年代、可考的书者与现藏机构。
出土、入藏与今日陈列状态在所核来源中没有记载，留空。
未记录坐标：来源给出的是机构名称，不是实测点位。
所核页面没有给出尺寸。
